live.instructions: Use this server for mortgage help in Spain. Choose the narrowest tool that matches the user request. Use mortgage simulation whenever the user wants a payment estimate, cost breakdown, or scenario comparison, even if you first need to gather missing required inputs. When that simulation intent is clear, do not answer with a self-computed estimate and do not avoid the tool; ask for the missing required values and then call the mortgage simulation tool. Apply the same rule to any calculation tool in this server: if the user wants the calculation and inputs are missing, ask for the missing required values and then call the tool instead of estimating the result yourself. Prefer affordability ratios only for early viability questions such as whether a property may be affordable or whether savings and income fit a target price when the user is not yet asking for a concrete simulation. Use purchase taxes for transaction-cost estimates, reference indexes for Euribor or IRPH lookups, and knowledge base search for documented Trioteca product, policy, or explanatory questions. Never invent missing financial inputs; ask for the missing required values before calling a calculation tool.

tools.name: calculate-mortgage-taxes
tools.title: Calculate purchase taxes
tools.description:
Estimates Spanish property purchase taxes and the transaction-tax cash impact.

Applies Spain-specific tax logic to produce a clear breakdown of applicable tax components.

Useful for understanding the fiscal layer of a purchase independently from financing terms.

currency.description: Currency used for all monetary amounts.

community.description: Spanish autonomous community where the property is located.

is_new_construction.description: Whether the property is a new build.

taxes.description: List of taxes that apply to the property purchase.

amount.description: Applied tax amount, including value and currency.

currency.description: Currency of the applied tax amount.

total_amount.description: Total tax amount, including value and currency.

currency.description: Currency of the total tax amount.

tools.name: calculate-associated-costs
tools.title: Calculate associated costs
tools.description:
Estimates non-tax associated costs for residential property operations in Spain.

Provides a deterministic cost breakdown across notary, property registry, agency, and appraisal concepts.

Designed for upfront cost visibility and scenario comparison, separate from purchase taxes.

currency.description: Currency used for all monetary amounts.

community.description: Spanish autonomous community where the property is located.

is_new_construction.description: Whether the property is a new build.

expenses.description: List of associated costs excluding taxes.

rate.description: Associated cost rate percentage when applicable, or zero for fixed-fee items.

amount.description: Associated cost amount, including value and currency.

currency.description: Currency of the associated cost amount.

total_amount.description: Total associated cost amount, excluding taxes.

currency.description: Currency of the total associated cost amount.

tools.name: get-mortgage-index
tools.title: Get mortgage reference index
tools.description:
Retrieves official Spanish mortgage reference indexes such as Euribor and IRPH.

Uses Bank of Spain sources to provide trusted market index context for mortgage analysis.

Supports both latest available observations and point-in-time monthly checks.

period.description: Specific month to retrieve (YYYY-MM) or "latest" for the latest available month.

unit.description: Unit used for the reference index value.

value.description: Reference index value for the requested month or the latest available month.

period.description: Month for which the returned index value applies, when available.

tools.name: search-knowledge-base
tools.title: Search knowledge base
tools.description:
Searches Trioteca's curated knowledge base for policy, product, process, eligibility, and explanatory mortgage questions.

Provides grounded answers aligned with documented Trioteca content to reduce ambiguity and hallucinations.

answer.description: Answer retrieved from the knowledge base.

tools.title: Calculate mortgage ratios
tools.description:
Evaluates mortgage affordability and viability for Spain.

Produces core decision ratios (LTC, LTV, DTI) to quantify financial fit and borrowing pressure.

Useful for fast viability screening before deeper mortgage scenario analysis.

tools.name: simulate-mortgage
tools.title: Simulate mortgage
tools.description:
Generates a complete mortgage simulation for Spain with deterministic financial outputs.

Combines installment projection, total financing cost, purchase taxes, associated costs, and affordability indicators in one coherent scenario.

Associated costs are represented separately from taxes to preserve financial clarity.
